summary: Tested the API security changes and the public page /para-desarrolladores. Backend: 20/20 tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter_api_security.py after two fixes to my own test. I had first used /v1/companies and /contacts, which do not exist; the real endpoints are /clients and /expenses. A 123/130 result in the first run came from my burst running across a minute boundary. Webhook SSRF guard: 15 bad URLs all return 400 with a Spanish message. They are localhost, 127.0.0.1, 169.254.169.254, 10.x, 192.168.x, 100.64.x, 0.0.0.0, [::1], [::ffff:127.0.0.1], decimal and hex IPs, localtest.me, http://, user:pw@ and .invalid. https://httpbin.org/post is accepted. The ping test logs a 200 delivery; on a deleted or unknown webhook it returns 404. Rate limit: the api_rate collection has a TTL index on exp (expireAfterSeconds 0) and docs keyed '<key_id>:<minute>' with n. Admin gets exactly 120 OK then 429; Platino (clidemo1) gets exactly 60 OK then 429. Retry-After is between 1 and 60, and a second key is not affected. Regression: /v1 me, clients, invoices and expenses return 200, X-API-Key also works, no key gives 401, and /v1/docs returns 200. Frontend: /para-desarrolladores loads without login and every requested testid is present and visible. Register and CTA go to /registro, back goes to /, and docs opens /api/v1/docs (Swagger) in a new tab. Home footer-api and pricing-footer-api go to the page, and /precios has the row 'API REST y webhooks'. At 390px there is no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth is 390). The /desarrolladores panel renders, and the webhook form shows the SSRF error toast. One content bug: the marketing page lists endpoints that do not exist.

minor.issue: DNS-rebinding gap: the URL is checked with getaddrinfo, then httpx resolves the host again on its own. An attacker's DNS could return a public IP for the check and 127.0.0.1 for the request. To close it, pin the checked IP for the connection (custom transport, or connect to the IP with a Host/SNI header). Redirects are already off (follow_redirects=False), which is good.
Fixed 1-minute window, so up to 2x the limit is possible across a boundary. Requests rejected with 429 still increment n. Both are acceptable; noting for awareness.

ui_bugs.issue: The page advertises 'GET /api/v1/companies' (Empresas card) and 'POST /api/v1/contacts' (Clientes card). Neither exists; both return 404. The real endpoints are GET /api/v1/me and GET/POST /api/v1/clients. Developers who copy these paths will get 404s.

issues: The event chips (api-page-events) leave out invoice.verifactu.error, which the backend EVENTS list and the panel do include (cosmetic).
